hooks.command: if git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" diff --quiet HEAD -- scripts/hooks/guard-protected-paths.sh; result=$?; if [ "$result" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"guard-protected-paths.sh differs from HEAD; review it before trusting it."}}'; else bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/guard-protected-paths.sh"; fi; else bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/guard-protected-paths.sh"; fi; exit 0

if ! git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" diff --quiet HEAD -- scripts/hooks/auto-verify.sh; then bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/auto-verify.sh" --mark-turn-start; fi

if ! git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" diff --quiet HEAD -- scripts/hooks/auto-verify.sh; then bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/auto-verify.sh"; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Auto-verify: quick check skipped until scripts/hooks/auto-verify.sh is reviewed and committed."}'; fi
